source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
After you get the first call, do not hang up the phone until you have a complete list of names and direct contact information for all of those who were affected.  (Some companies include medical costs in the reportable.  For many other companies, medical costs are not reportable.)
3. Accurately complete the incident records, including the names of affected employees, witnesses, and supervisors or company personnel who are directly tied to the accident.
4. Use this as a template for follow-up documentation.  Go to each person involved in the accident and accurately complete a witness statement using only their personal knowledge.
5. Complete a supervisor / company representative witness statement for every supervisor or company representative who has any knowledge, information, or observations about the incident.
6. Complete a cause analysis to determine root cause and corrective actions to be considered. And make copies of your cause analysis.
